data.Ui.About.Description: STP / STEP 3D Viewer. Open, measure, align, check interference, section, and export without starting a full CAD application.
data.Ui.About.Name: Name
data.Ui.About.Release010.Change1: • STEP, STL, and DXF import with an assembly tree; point, distance, edge, face, circle, angle, and face-distance measurement; alignment, interference checking, sections, units, CSV, and screenshots.
data.Ui.About.Release010.Title: First Release
data.Ui.About.Release020.Change1: • Hold the left mouse button on a part to drag it into position.
data.Ui.About.Release020.Change2: • Version 0.2.1 fixed a crash after clicking a dragged part.
data.Ui.About.Release020.Title: Drag Mode
data.Ui.About.Release030.Change1: • Select a model and use XYZ arrows to move it along an axis or rings to rotate it by any angle.
data.Ui.About.Release030.Title: 3-Axis Gizmo
data.Ui.About.Release031.Change1: • The 3-axis gizmo stays above the model and remains accessible from any angle.
data.Ui.About.Release031.Title: Gizmo Always Visible
data.Ui.About.Release032.Change1: • Rotating a large assembly remains smooth while measuring.
data.Ui.About.Release032.Title: Smooth Measurement of Large Assemblies
data.Ui.About.Release040.Change1: • Moving the section slider on a large file no longer freezes the window.
data.Ui.About.Release040.Change2: • Placement after dragging or using the gizmo is much faster.
data.Ui.About.Release040.Change3: • Errors now show a message and let the application keep running.
data.Ui.About.Release040.Title: Faster and More Reliable
data.Ui.About.Release050.Change1: • Distance measurement snaps to the center of a circular edge, making hole pitch easy to measure.
data.Ui.About.Release050.Change2: • Measurement shortcuts: P point, D distance, E edge, F face, C circle, A angle, M face distance; Esc cancels.
data.Ui.About.Release050.Change3: • Search part names in the model tree; right-click to isolate a node or measure volume and centroid.
data.Ui.About.Release050.Change4: • Standard views and orthographic projection make dimensions easier to inspect without perspective distortion.
data.Ui.About.Release050.Change5: • A three-point section mode cuts along any plane defined by three points on the model.
data.Ui.About.Release050.Change6: • Export aligned parts to a new STEP file for use in CAD.
data.Ui.About.Release050.Change7: • Window size, unit preferences, and the ten most recently opened files are remembered.
data.Ui.About.Release050.Title: Major Improvements to Measurement, Views, and the Model Tree
data.Ui.About.Release060.Change1: • Export visible parts, including their aligned and rotated positions, to STL for 3D printing or other software.
data.Ui.About.Release060.Change2: • Choose one merged file or one file per model, Binary or ASCII, mm or inches, and mesh quality before exporting.
data.Ui.About.Release060.Change3: • The settings dialog shows triangle count and estimated file size immediately.
data.Ui.About.Release060.Title: Export STL
data.Ui.About.Release070.Change1: • A new menu bar groups all features under File, View, Measure, Transform, and Tools.
data.Ui.About.Release070.Change2: • Choose your favorite Quick Bar buttons from Quick Bar → Customize Buttons; your selection is saved.
data.Ui.About.Release070.Change3: • Section controls appear only when section view is active.
data.Ui.About.Release070.Change4: • A new About window shows the release history.
data.Ui.About.Release070.Title: Redesigned Interface with Menus and a Customizable Quick Bar
data.Ui.About.Release071.Change1: • Large STL mesh files with millions of triangles now open almost instantly instead of taking several minutes.
data.Ui.About.Release071.Change2: • For example, a 75 MB STL with 1.5 million triangles now appears in under a second.
data.Ui.About.Release071.Title: Open Large STL Files in Seconds
data.Ui.About.Technology: .NET 8 · WPF · C#; CADability (STEP / B-rep geometry); HelixToolkit (3D display and camera)
